faq: On 30 November 2026 at 23:59 (Baku time, UTC+4). After that, prices go back to normal.
What will I pay at renewal?
If you subscribe during the offer, every renewal stays at the discounted price until you cancel: {y} a year or {m} a month.
Yes. Once you cancel, no new payment is taken, and Premium stays with you until the end of the period you paid for.
I already have Premium. Can I use the offer?
This offer is for accounts that don't have active Premium yet. If your Premium is already on, you don't need a new subscription.
How does Premium turn on in the app?
Premium is linked to the Anacan account you sign in with on this page. Sign in to the app with the same account (Google, Apple or email) and Premium turns on automatically.
pay_faq_epoint: Payment is taken in manat on the Epoint payment page of Pasha Bank. Your card is stored securely at the bank for automatic renewal; Anacan only sees the masked number (•••• 1234).
pay_faq_dodo: Payment is processed in US dollars by Dodo Payments (Merchant of Record). You enter your card details on Dodo's secure page; Anacan never sees your card number. To cancel, use the subscription link in Dodo's email.
end_note: The offer ends on 30 November 2026 at 23:59 (Baku time).
